Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hagipower: add DLC disable override support to game driver (b3c12a7)
  • frontend-config: add DLC-aware update preparation and diagnostics (9f8a64e)
  • dlc: add host state tracking and disable override support (4f1246f)
  • dlc: add debug state API for DLC disable override (3e85c66)

HagiCode-org/web

  • system: add host state fields to DLC installation DTO (11c8d03)
  • hagipower: add daily consumption display to status bar (010d8a7)
  • settings: add partial save warnings for DLC-gated settings (830dbb0)
  • settings: add DLC gate handling to brand customization (80c806e)
  • frontend-config: add DLC feature disabled diagnostics (d9f90b6)
  • services: add DLC debug state service for backend-managed override (ac1937b)
  • proposals,session: add profession color support to hero cards (8151620)
  • hero: propagate profession colors to hero config and roster panels (c9dc54b)
  • hero: add primary label color support to hero cards and filters (dbef726)
  • hero: add profession color resolver utility with safety validation (6eb2c56)
